_about: Every business fact stated on the site, copied from src/index.html, src/private-office-islamabad.html and src/team-office-space-islamabad.html. Content pages (src/pages/*.json) may only state prices and hours that appear in this file; npm run check enforces it. Change a fact here only after it has changed on the site (or in the same change). Nothing under "conflicts" counts as an allowed fact.

business.name: CoNinja Coworking
business.summary: Coworking space and private offices in E-11/3, Islamabad.
business.offers: Coworking seats, team space and executive private offices at Professional Arcade, E-11/3.
business.community: More than just desks. We bring founders, freelancers, creators and professionals together under one roof.

location.address: 1st Floor, Professional Arcade, MPCHS E-11/3, Islamabad 44000

nearby_sectors.as_stated: E-11/3 is next to F-11 and close to F-10, G-11 and D-12.

contact.channel: WhatsApp only. Bookings are handled on WhatsApp only; there is no phone line.

hours.summary: Open 24 hours from Monday to Friday, 12 PM to 12:30 AM on Saturday and 12 PM to midnight on Sunday.
hours.holidays: Hours can change on public holidays. Message us before you come.
hours.night_work: We don't close between Monday and Friday, so you can work US or UK hours from a proper desk.
hours.night_example: Come in at 9 PM and leave at 6 AM, Monday to Friday.

plans.name: Coworking seat
plans.for: For freelancers and remote workers who want a proper desk away from home.
plans.team_size: Teams of 5 to 10 people or more can work together in the coworking space.
plans.bills: Not stated. For a seat or a private office, ask us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm what's covered.

plans.name: Studio Office
plans.price: Not published. Ask us on WhatsApp.

terms.security_deposit: A security deposit is needed for a coworking seat, team space and a private office. The deposit is the same amount as the plan's price.
terms.minimum_stay: Not stated. Ask us on WhatsApp.
terms.source: Confirmed by CoNinja on 18 November 2026. Not yet written on the site's own pages.

price_range: PKR 1,000 a day to PKR 55,000+ a month
all_plans_include: Every plan in our shared office space comes with internet, air conditioning and tea and coffee.
free_trial: A free trial of 1 to 3 hours. After that, a day pass is PKR 1,000 per day.
free_tour: Tours are free and there's nothing to sign. Book a free tour on WhatsApp at 0327 5393390 or with the tour form on the home page, and visit during opening hours.
facilities: Lounge and table tennis (sofas, a TV and a table)
joining: Message us or book a tour

competitors._rule: Facts about other businesses, copied from their own public pages on the date checked. A page may state one only as theirs, says when it was checked, and never presents it as a fact about CoNinja. Where a value says "Not published", do not estimate it. Name no winner and make no claim about a competitor that is not here.
